selection.rule: ascending SHA256 UTF8(seed + ':' + decimal_id), then ID; take 24

screening.lexical: TF count times IDF, cosine; explicit STOP terms in script; top 8 unique old roots; retains list/string/number tokens
screening.structural: identifier-erased function AST exact hash plus AST node-bigram cosine; constants retained; shared function names; best structural flag across source variants may differ from best lexical variant
screening.threshold: >=0.60 cosine prompts review only; never auto-certifies/excludes a family
screening.limitations: Lexical and AST similarities neither prove semantic equivalence nor certify independence. Structural similarity loses binding details. No task code executed.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Description says dictionary; reference/tests consume a sequence of words and return top four (word,count) pairs. Four, ordering and tie behavior are absent. Frequency/mode prior tasks share ingredients, but this is not an established identical endpoint.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Specify sequence input, top-four ordered output and ties as a versioned repaired task; preserve original exclusion.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Sorted missing-number search is close to old627 and selected371/189, with a one-based single-gap variant. Missing range/gap assumptions are unspecified. Third original test gives N=5 for six elements; N cannot silently be labeled array length.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Resolve domain and N semantics; cannot call this an unseen family even after specification repair.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Prompt asks whether rearrangement is possible; reference constructs a string and tests demand one exact ordering. Multiple valid rearrangements may be rejected by the literal grader.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Choose feasibility Boolean or constructed arrangement; if construction, grade its properties rather than a single arbitrary reference ordering. Requires new endpoint version.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Same lowercase-underscore regex predicate as old16. Original-source function AST matches after identifier erasure; sanitized old16 returns Boolean while selected43 expects two magic strings absent from the prompt.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Exclude from a prospective unseen-family claim. Any repaired return convention requires a new public specification.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Regex tasks about z share a coding idiom but have different predicates. Selected44 expects exact magic success/failure strings without specifying them, and word-character convention is unstated.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Specify Boolean or exact output convention and word definition; this repairs the public target.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Rectangle-area prior458 has the same two-input multiplication shape, but geometry differs. Treat as a potential broad geometry family, not proof of duplicate task identity or independent family. Formula and interface are otherwise conventional.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Define base and perpendicular height and allowed numeric domain; root/family partition must not assume this arithmetic shape is independent.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Cylinder perimeter is not a unique geometric quantity. Reference computes twice diameter plus height, compatible with a particular rectangular cross-section, not a defined perimeter of a solid.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Replace with an explicit cross-section quantity or withdraw; doing so creates a revised task.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Run-length encoding is recognizable but prompt does not specify pairs as [count,value], run order, or list versus string handling; tests rely on that representation.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Publish an explicit run encoding/output schema before generation; version the repaired target.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Month-length classification is a related calendar operation rather than the same task. Season boundaries and hemisphere/convention are unspecified; wording says print while tests expect a return value.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Fix calendar convention, boundaries, input spelling/domain and return behavior in a revised public contract.

adjudications.manual_rationale: First missing positive in an unsorted array generalizes the same missing-integer family as old627 and selected34/371, although algorithm, ordering and zero handling differ. Extra n and input mutation are not explained by prose.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Resolve n/domain/mutation semantics; do not present as an unseen task family.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Selected202 retains zero-based even indices, exactly the operation old226 describes; old437 is the complementary alternating selection. Even characters is ambiguous without indexing convention.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Exclude due to prior operation identity; retain provenance even if repaired.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Same punctuation substitution as old732 with a count parameter. Python re.sub count=0 replaces all, conflicting with a literal maximum of zero occurrences unless n is restricted to positive integers.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Specify positive count or repair zero-count behavior; prospective family remains previously represented.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Given year suggests one calendar year, whereas source counts excess weekdays accumulated over N years using leap/century corrections. The time interval and origin are absent.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: State cumulative interval/calendar convention or change reference/evaluator; cannot silently infer target from solution.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Same month-length classification family with 28 replacing 30/31 and names replacing numbers. Every month contains at least28 days; reference instead selects February, without leap-year semantics.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Specify exactly28 in a nonleap calendar and input convention if repairing; still a represented family.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Tuple-record top-k and word unique-letter maximum are different targets; shared find_max name is not a duplicate. Source casts each item to int, so arbitrary numeric inputs would not implement their true maximum. Tests use integer tuples.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Explicitly constrain to nonempty tuple records of integers or repair source/evaluator. Retention is conditional and does not certify original prose for broader inputs.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Counting decimal digits of an integer differs from counting digit characters in mixed text (old764). Source returns zero for0 and repeated floor division of negative integers never reaches0. This is a static control-flow finding, not an executed failure.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Restrict to strictly positive integers explicitly or repair zero/negative handling and evaluator; preserve version distinction.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Both locate first missing nonnegative integer in a sorted sequence by index-based search. Selected left/right arguments and nonnegative zero-origin universe are absent from prose.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Exclude prior family; clarify sorted distinct nonnegative domain and search bounds for any revised version.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Cube and triangular-prism volume tasks are related elementary geometry but have different parameterizations/formulas. No exact task identity established; broad geometry transfer remains possible.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Define length,width,height and admissible units/numeric domain; do not equate a distinct solid with a proven independent family.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Moving final element to front differs from swapping endpoints (old625/591). Digit circular-shift HE65 is related but includes integer/string-specific behavior and arbitrary shifts.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Specify returned list and empty-list behavior; count as development only pending semantic review and scorer validation.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Minimum swaps depends on adjacent-only versus arbitrary swaps, absent from prose. Source accumulates adjacent distances. Balance recognition and binary-string transformation prior tasks are related, not identical optimization endpoints.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Specify adjacent swap cost, bracket alphabet, and equal-count/feasibility assumptions before scoring.

adjudications.manual_rationale: nCr modulo p is recognizable. Other binomial-sum tasks share mathematical ingredients but compute different functions. Source uses dynamic programming and does not require prime p.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Specify integers n>=0,0<=r<=n,p>0; do not unnecessarily restrict p to primes. Validate evaluator separately.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Area is determined from one side only for a regular pentagon, unstated. Original assertions compare floating-point outputs by exact equality; mathematically valid equivalent formulas may round differently. Perimeter prior171 is related but a different target.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: State regularity and side length; freeze justified numeric tolerance and negative controls before grading. This changes the original literal endpoint.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Counting a supplied target value (old168) differs from finding maximum then counting its occurrences. This is a related composition, not established semantic duplicate; source extra n must be documented.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Specify nonempty numeric sequence and n=len(arr), return count, and mutation behavior; no family-independence certificate.

adjudications.manual_rationale: Mean of positive odd integers through n is different from filtering/selecting odd list values. Positive-odd domain is conventional but not explicit; negative odd inputs yield zero-count division by static inspection.
adjudications.required_contract_resolution: Explicitly restrict n to positive odd integers; do not claim an unrestricted integer target. Retained as a plausible domain clarification, not as a validated task.
